title: twin/gateway/status
description: Every 5 s. Fields the SDK cannot provide are omitted, never invented. Only ts_ms is required.

ts_ms.description: Board time in ms when the sample was taken (kept on buffered replays).

buffered.description: Messages flushed from the offline buffer on the last reconnect.

replay.description: true on messages flushed from the offline buffer. The backend keeps them in history but does not treat them as the current status.
